title: Native Gameface page resources and regular response interception boundary
status: Offline format parsing and reviewed original-game request paths; no custom engine-rendered page has been gameplay-verified.

middleware.evidence: Exported IAsyncResourceResponse vtable: one deleting destructor followed by eight pure-virtual entries, then another object. This fixes table length, not every method signature.

packed_asset.container: Versioned ui::PageResource serialization, not a standalone HTML document.

file_table.shape: 20-byte object header, u32 path-byte count, path bytes, 32-byte serialized resource reference, u64 source offset, u64 source length, 4-byte closing magic.

packed_asset.format_limits: The table and all embedded source bounds were checked. Trailing binding, navigation, event and other serialized arrays are not fully reconstructed; this is not a general PageResource writer.

file_record_fields.0x108: external resource reference or invalid sentinel

regular_request.normalization: Normalizes URL/path and strips the base prefix before comparing registered resource paths. Query/fragment handling occurs in the normalizer; matching arbitrary user paths is not a supported mod API.
regular_request.embedded_branch: When matching record source length is nonzero, read page blob + record source offset, allocate response storage, copy exactly source length bytes, finish success and return.

response_slots_reviewed.observed_contract: Allocate writable response buffer for byte length passed in RDX; return buffer pointer in RAX.
Texture/user-image response descriptor on separate texture branch; not used for embedded HTML/JS. Full descriptor ownership is unresolved.
Set response status to integer 200 before successful byte-buffer responses.
Finish response with integer result 0 on success or 1 on failure. This is the final method slot in this middleware build.

regular_request.lifetime: The embedded regular-request branch allocates, copies and finishes within the original call. It does not retain the request or response pointer. This does not establish a universal synchronous contract for other handlers, middleware builds or streaming requests.
regular_request.other_paths: External font/data resources use the shared resource manager; texture branches call the native renderer and use a different response method. These must remain delegated to the original handler.
regular_request.stream_request: Separate entry 0x3444ce0 uses a different response interface, with finish at +0x10. Do not apply the regular-response layout to it.
regular_request.abort_slot: Handler vtable +0x18 points to 0x3444ff0, a no-op ret. Interface naming suggests abort, but the body establishes no cancellation ownership protocol.

minimal_panel_candidate.route: Append bounded self-authored markup/script to the existing ui.html response before its unique closing body tag, using the game-owned Gameface renderer.
minimal_panel_candidate.alternative: Serve a namespaced self-authored child resource through the same native resource handler, while delegating unrelated requests unchanged.
minimal_panel_candidate.limits: This adds content to an existing page; it does not prove arbitrary ECS page creation, page-stack activation, input focus, navigation binding or Wasm-to-JavaScript event delivery.
requirements: Exact executable/middleware fingerprints and request entry validation.
Match an explicitly supported URL and verified original embedded content; reject ambiguous or altered content.
Never retain raw engine resource/request/response pointers beyond proven scope.
Bound transformed response size and preserve original content on refusal.
Establish callback threading/reentrancy and page reload teardown before exposing mod-owned event subscriptions.

public_distribution: Only layouts, hashes and code-reference metadata are recorded here. Extracted game HTML, scripts, styles and packed resources remain local.
